title_sub: Nvidia's CEO is out, and 9 more

stocks.name: Nvidia
stocks.headline: Its founder-CEO is out
stocks.body: Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and left the board, effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. The stock hit a 52-week low before cutting its loss.

stocks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
stocks.headline: Rivals rally on Nvidia news
stocks.body: AMD climbed as Nvidia's CEO stepped down. Nvidia's rivals also jumped on Monday, when its board opened an investigation into him.

stocks.name: Broadcom
stocks.headline: Rival chips keep climbing
stocks.body: Broadcom rose with AMD as Nvidia changed CEOs. On Monday, when Nvidia's board opened its probe, Broadcom had its best day since last November.

stocks.name: Strategy
stocks.headline: Out of the MSCI index
stocks.body: MSCI is dropping Strategy, the biggest corporate bitcoin holder, from its US index at the November 30 close. Funds that track the index will have to sell.

stocks.name: Nebius Group
stocks.headline: Sales up 571%, goal delayed
stocks.body: Nebius grew revenue 571% to $980.8 million, but pushed back its goal of a $7 billion yearly sales pace from December to February.

stocks.name: Corteva
stocks.headline: Brazil hits the forecast
stocks.body: Corteva cut its 2026 forecast on a weaker Brazil market, and third-quarter sales fell 9% to $1.59 billion. MSCI is also dropping it from its US index.

stocks.name: YETI Holdings
stocks.headline: A cooler sales forecast
stocks.body: YETI cut its 2026 sales growth outlook to about 6% from 7–8%, pointing to a more cautious shopper.

stocks.name: Mobility Global
stocks.headline: An $800 million buyback
stocks.body: The owner of CARFAX grew revenue 7.4% to $478 million, raised the middle of its profit forecast and approved an $800 million buyback.

stocks.name: Intuitive Machines
stocks.headline: A record $1.9B backlog
stocks.body: The moon-lander company posted record quarterly revenue of $269 million and a record order backlog of $1.9 billion.

stocks.name: ADI Global Distribution
stocks.headline: Half its value in a day
stocks.body: The security-gear distributor cut its 2026 outlook. Its $655 million quarterly loss included a $659 million write-down of past deals.
